content: Human-labeling session — combat-suicide-charge-mission:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a strike on a defended enemy Construction Yard on a 56x40 arena. You are given a ten-unit strike package — 6 medium tanks and 4 rocket soldiers (anti-vehicle Dragon launchers, range 5), all on Return-Fire orders — staging in either the north band (around y=10) or the south band (around y=30), chosen by seed. A water cordon at mid-map (x=24..27) leaves only a narrow y=15..25 corridor open between the staging bands and the east half. The enemy Construction Yard at (50,20) is guarded by 2 rocket soldiers at (46,17) and (46,23) and a Mammoth tank pulled back to (52,20), all on guard orders — they hold their post but lunge at any of your units within roughly 16 cells. Destroy the yard within 7200 ticks.
